title: Disturbance gauntlet · Level 3: Twenty plants, one tuning
brief: Practice only, no pass, until the owner rules on the plants it draws (owner item G114-2): with the loads on, some drawn plants (a small b x tau, or a small b against the loads) cannot hold 300 deg/s at full duty, so every controller scores 0 on those runs. Level 1's task on the flywheel bench (an EV3 Medium on port 3 turning a 341.5 g disc of 50 mm radius and a pulley of 9 mm radius with a 200 g load on its cord), its motor drawn per run: b x 0.5 to 2, tau x 0.5 to 2, Coulomb friction 0 to 20 % of full duty, and on some runs one extra 10 ms sample of delay. One tuning, chosen before the runs are drawn. The three loads are fixed: 4 mN m at 1.0 s, 8 at 2.5 s and 12 at 4.0 s, each staying on; the run is read on the true speed from 1.0 s to 6.0 s, where it ends. J = 0.8 x IAE / 56.9 + 0.2 x TV / 33.7; the run scores 100 x clamp(2 - J, 0, 1). Your own controller over dc() on Motor(3) (a built-in run(), track() or hold() scores 0); hand in your PID too: at Run challenge pick it as the comparison program, and it runs on the same seed, scored the same way, for the ADRC / PID ratio of IAE over the runs both take through the window on your own controller (a run of either on a built-in law is not paired) - shown on the card and sealed in your submission, never scored. Twenty runs. Par: IAE 56.9 deg, TV 33.7 %.

score.run: if(windowDone & moveTicks == 0, 100 * clamp(2 - (0.8 * iae / IAE_PAR + 0.2 * tv / TV_PAR), 0, 1), 0)
